verdict.rationale: OpenHands' CLI mode provides an interactive terminal experience with instant feedback and an Esc-to-pause control, while the Agent Server exposes a WebSocket/HTTP API and the Agent Canvas serves as a browser-based control center for live agent conversations, and the conversation-goals guide explicitly describes UI progress display with stop/resume controls. Together these show real-time visibility into agent actions and status, though the pack lacks a dedicated 'live status dashboard' screenshot or independent hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of real-time monitoring UX, and explicit documentation of a persistent status indicator beyond CLI/Canvas mentions.
